about: The payload-shape registry (TL-1; docs/design/telemetry-links.md section 3): which JSON keys carry frame tuples. Universal defaults, data only. A key not named here (a message, a breadcrumb, the user, metaData) is never read. frame_arrays: an array of frame objects; trace_texts: a raw trace string (or an array of trace lines) read by the raw parser (Lambda's Node runtime writes trace, its Python and Java runtimes stackTrace, a PHP runtime layer stack); code_attributes: one frame from OpenTelemetry code.* attributes, ranked after every stack frame; causes: chained errors read root cause first (a nested cause before its holder, a listed-root-last array last-first); never_read: subtrees never entered; attribute_lists: OTLP JSON's [{key, value: {stringValue|intValue}}] lists read as keys of the object holding them.
